_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-scheduler container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-scheduler container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-scheduler container in MiB

deployment.description: mod-scheduler uses a clustered Quartz JDBC job store, so replicas coordinate through PostgreSQL and each timer fires on exactly one replica; a single timer never overlaps itself across the cluster. Kafka consumers share a consumer group per module version, so scheduled-job and entitlement events are processed once across replicas. Keycloak/system-user/client-secret/token caches are local to each replica. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient; the timer REST API only persists timer descriptors and schedules Quartz jobs, and timer HTTP calls are executed asynchronously by Quartz rather than through Kong.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the mod-scheduler tenant schemas and the Quartz schema (sys_quartz_mod_scheduler)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host. Used to consume scheduled-job and entitlement events and to publish event-confirmation results

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka client key store. Applies when KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL requires SSL client authentication

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka client key store

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka client trust store. Applies when KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL is SSL

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka client trust store

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_MAX_POLL_RECORDS
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single Kafka consumer poll() call

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_JOB_CONSUMER_PATTERN
EnvVars.description: Topic name pattern for the scheduled-job topic filled by mgr-tenant-entitlements

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_JOB_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent threads for the scheduled-job Kafka consumer

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_ENTITLEMENT_CONSUMER_PATTERN
EnvVars.description: Topic name pattern for the entitlement topic filled by mgr-tenant-entitlements

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_ENTITLEMENT_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent threads for the entitlement-events Kafka consumer

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables marker-table-based Kafka tenant filtering for mixed-version deployments. Set to true when this deployment shares a Kafka cluster/topic with another module version

EnvVars.name: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables publishing of SUCCESS/FAILURE confirmations to mgr-tenant-entitlements after processing a scheduled-job event

EnvVars.name: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TOPIC
EnvVars.description: Kafka topic used to publish scheduled-job event confirmation results. Applies when EVENT_CONFIRMATION_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix and as the default first segment of the secure store key; must match the value used by the other modules

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL used to perform HTTP requests for scheduled timers (Okapi or API gateway). Required for timer execution

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Deployed module version. Required for mixed-version deployments and must exactly match MODULE_VERSION of the associated sidecar

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-scheduler process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: QUARTZ_STARTUP_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Delay before the Quartz scheduler starts after application startup

EnvVars.name: QUARTZ_SCHEDULER_IDLE_WAIT_TIME
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds the Quartz scheduler waits before re-querying for available triggers when idle

EnvVars.name: QUARTZ_MISFIRE_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Number of milliseconds the scheduler tolerates a trigger passing its next fire time before treating it as misfired

EnvVars.name: QUARTZ_CLUSTER_CHECKIN_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Frequency in milliseconds at which this instance checks in with the other instances of the Quartz cluster. Affects how quickly failed instances are detected

EnvVars.name: QUARTZ_POOL_THREAD_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Number of threads available for concurrent execution of jobs

EnvVars.name: SCHEDULER_API_ALLOW_SYSTEM_TIMER_MUTATION
EnvVars.description: Allow REST APIs to create, update and delete SYSTEM timers

EnvVars.name: SCHEDULER_API_ALLOW_USER_ID_UPDATE
EnvVars.description: Allow a USER timer's userId to be refreshed to the updating user on update. When false, userId is set once on creation and preserved across updates

EnvVars.name: SCHEDULER_SYSTEM_TIMER_INITIAL_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Initial delay for SYSTEM delay-based timers. Skipped for USER timers, cron timers and SYSTEM timers whose interval is less than or equal to the configured delay

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_USERNAME_TEMPLATE
EnvVars.description: Template used to generate the system user username for each tenant

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Retry delay between attempts to retrieve the system user

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_MAX_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Maximum delay between attempts to retrieve the system user

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retry attempts to retrieve the system user (default is effectively infinite)

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_RETRY_MULTIPLIER
EnvVars.description: Retry delay multiplier for attempts to retrieve the system user

EnvVars.name: USER_IMPERSONATION_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Retry delay between attempts to obtain a user impersonation token for scheduled job execution

EnvVars.name: USER_IMPERSONATION_MAX_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Maximum delay between attempts to obtain a user impersonation token

EnvVars.name: USER_IMPERSONATION_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retry attempts to obtain a user impersonation token

EnvVars.name: USER_IMPERSONATION_RETRY_MULTIPLIER
EnvVars.description: Retry delay multiplier for attempts to obtain a user impersonation token

EnvVars.name: SCHEDULED_TIMER_EVENT_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Retry delay between attempts to process an event from the scheduled-job Kafka topic

EnvVars.name: SCHEDULED_TIMER_EVENT_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of attempts to process an event from the scheduled-job Kafka topic (default is effectively infinite)

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_EVENT_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Retry delay between attempts to process an event from the entitlement Kafka topic

EnvVars.name: ENTITLEMENT_EVENT_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of attempts to process an event from the entitlement Kafka topic (default is effectively infinite)

EnvVars.name: TIMER_EXECUTION_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Initial backoff before the first retry of a timer HTTP call

EnvVars.name: TIMER_EXECUTION_RETRY_MAX_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Ceiling for the backoff between timer HTTP call retries

EnvVars.name: TIMER_EXECUTION_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of attempts for a timer HTTP call, including the initial one; 1 disables retries

EnvVars.name: TIMER_EXECUTION_RETRY_MULTIPLIER
EnvVars.description: Exponential multiplier applied to the backoff between timer HTTP call retries

EnvVars.name: CLIENT_SECRET_KEY_CACHE_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time to live for cached client secrets read from the secure store

EnvVars.name: CLIENT_SECRET_KEY_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of cached client secrets

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_INITIAL_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Initial capacity of the impersonation token cache

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_MAX_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Maximum capacity of the impersonation token cache

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_REFRESH_PRIOR_EXPIRATION
EnvVars.description: Number of seconds before token expiration at which a cached token is invalidated and refreshed

EnvVars.name: KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables Keycloak integration. When false, all Keycloak-related beans are excluded from the Spring context

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Keycloak base URL used to perform Keycloak requests

EnvVars.name: KC_IMPERSONATION_CLIENT
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client with permission to impersonate users, used to obtain tokens for scheduled job execution

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin client ID used for issuing admin tokens. Its secret is read from the secure store, not from an environment variable

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the Keycloak clients

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for the Keycloak clients. Required when KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the Keycloak clients

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the Keycloak clients (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend holding client secrets (e.g. the Keycloak admin client secret). Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP. The application falls back to VAULT when unset

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. Defaults to the value of ENV, with fallback to 'folio'

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; when unset the AWS default region provider chain is used

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: The HTTP endpoint used to retrieve AWS credentials. Ignored when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is true

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path component of the credentials endpoint URI, appended to SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Token for accessing Vault, may be a root token. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Address of the Vault instance. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to Vault

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to an X.509 certificate in unencrypted PEM format (UTF-8), used for Vault SSL verification

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password used to access the Vault client JKS keystore

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS keystore file containing a Vault client cert and private key

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS truststore file containing trusted Vault server certs

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the Folio Secure Store Proxy (FSSP). Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_SECRET_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path within FSSP where module secrets are stored/retrieved

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the truststore file used for the FSSP SSL connection

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the FSSP client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the FSSP truststore file

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container, in MB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation for the sidecar container, in MB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-scheduler backend container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-scheduler module deployed alongside this sidecar. Must exactly match the backend container's own MODULE_VERSION
